checker_mutations.rationale: needs_data requires null quantity and blocked approval.
Rule IDs must be a list, not a string containing expected substrings.
Item supplier must agree with request and supplier_groups.
Explanation must be text, not boolean true.
Any non-null recommended quantity must be nonnegative.
Recommendation units must preserve the input base unit.

findings.title: Subset comparison does not enforce a shared response schema or cross-field invariants.
Float subtraction happens before Decimal batch rounding, causing a full extra batch.
Float monetary arithmetic can block an exactly sufficient budget.
Receipt late in horizon leaves post-ETA shortages unflagged despite normal recommendation.
Negative quantities, prices, lead/review periods and accounted obligations are accepted.
Economic source is replaced by a fixed synthetic label.
Known supplier constraint is ignored when the other constraint is unknown; provisional quantity semantics need clarification.
Malformed receipt/commitment dates affect totals but disappear from the calendar path.
Probability tolerance and q=1 traversal disagree: deterministic demand280 yields target0.

limitations: No external production calculator is present or tested.
Adversarial deterministic checks are not a representative reliability sample.
The54-item independent ledger covers quantity/status only, not every response field.
Raw prices are interpreted as per base unit; price-per-order-unit semantics are not defined by the fixture contract.
Revision approval, ingestion idempotency, database effects, real stockouts and customer behavior are outside this local calculator.
